title: Verifier on Encoded Graphs
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $A$ be a Boolean matrix indexed by $	ext{Fin}(n)\times\text{Fin}(n)$, and let $r$ be a finite bit string. On the encoding of the graph specified by $A$, the matching verifier accepts exactly when $r$ has length at least $n^2$ times the number of Lovász bits for $n$, and the determinant of the sampled, adjacency-masked matrix over the corresponding Lovász prime field is nonzero.
